items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a part of that in my book [Danny Barker, A Life in Jazz, ed. Alyn Shipton (1986), chapter 4].

ctx.x: How was that related to you?

That’s related to my grandmother. His people Arthidores. He was a trombone player and all them kind of people, and he was interrelated to people. So that thing went spread out like a tree leaves. I got a part of that in my book [Danny Barker, A Life in Jazz, ed. Alyn Shipton (1986), chapter 4].
Yeah, I read that about your family. You mention quite a few famous musicians in the family in addition to the Barbarins. You say that Louis Barbarin’s daughter had married Louis Nelson, right?
